description: Implementation of string utility functions for string manipulation, comparison, trimming, case conversion, and placeholder replacement within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ReplacementOffset
classes.description: Tracks position of replaced parameters in string placeholders.

classes.name: SubstringMatcher
classes.description: Matches substrings within strings for replacement operations.

classes.name: CharacterMatcher
classes.description: Matches individual characters within strings for replacement operations.

methods.name: CompareParameter
methods.description: Compares ReplacementOffset objects based on parameter index.

methods.name: IsAlignedToMachineWord
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is aligned to machine word boundary.

methods.name: AlignToMachineWord
methods.description: Aligns a pointer to the nearest machine word boundary.

methods.name: ToLowerASCIIImpl
methods.description: Converts a string view to lowercase ASCII.

methods.name: ToUpperASCIIImpl
methods.description: Converts a string view to uppercase ASCII.

methods.name: CompareCaseInsensitiveASCIIT
methods.description: Compares two strings case-insensitively in ASCII.

methods.name: ReplaceCharsT
methods.description: Replaces characters in a string based on find and replace sets.

methods.name: TrimStringT
methods.description: Trims specified characters from the start and end of a string.

methods.name: TrimStringPieceT
methods.description: Returns a trimmed view of a string based on specified characters.

methods.name: TruncateUTF8ToByteSize
methods.description: Truncates a UTF-8 string to a specified byte size, ensuring valid UTF-8.

methods.name: CollapseWhitespaceT
methods.description: Reduces sequences of whitespace to a single space, optionally trimming line breaks.

methods.name: DoReplaceMatchesAfterOffset
methods.description: Performs replacement of substrings or characters in a string efficiently.

methods.name: JoinStringT
methods.description: Joins a list of strings with a separator.

methods.name: DoReplaceStringPlaceholders
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a format string with provided substitutions.
